name: Valeria
description: A writer in a creative and marital crisis finds refuge and support in her three best friends. Based on the novels by Elisabet Benavent.

videos.title: The Impostor
videos.overview: In the midst of writer's block and a deadline coming up, Val leans on her friends for support and meets a charming and flirty new man.

videos.title: Signs
videos.overview: An inspired Val works on the first draft of her erotic novel and receives feedback. Adri starts his new job. Lola gets frustrated with Sergio.

videos.title: Alaska
videos.overview: As tension builds between Val and Adri, she accompanies Victor to an art exhibition. Carmen checks out a new apartment with an intriguing landlord.

videos.title: The Pond
videos.overview: Adri is introduced to Victor. Nerea enjoys meeting a new group of women. Conflict arises between Val and her friends at Lola's big trap party.

videos.title: Mr Champi
videos.overview: Val heads to Valencia to celebrate her mom's birthday and clear her head after the events at Lola's party, but her trip doesn't go as expected.

videos.title: My Garden Is Dry
videos.overview: Lola's revelation results in conflict. Feeling energized about her book, Val meets with her editor again. Issues arise at Nerea's feminist collective.

videos.title: The Package
videos.overview: Victor and Val discuss their feelings for each other while spending the day together. Lola confronts her estranged mother.

videos.title: Ellipsis
videos.overview: Val comes to a realization about her relationship with Adri just as Victor begins to understand how important she is to him. Nerea tells her truth.

videos.title: Stop Running
videos.overview: Val returns to Madrid and must make crucial decisions about her career and love life. Carmen is nervous to tell Borja they'll be competing for a job.

videos.title: If You Don't Know What to Do, Write
videos.overview: Val has two contrasting reunions with Adri and Victor. Sparks fly when Nerea confronts a former adversary. Lola connects with an ex.

videos.title: A Book Isn't Just a Book
videos.overview: Victor invites Val to meet his parents. Lola feels conflicted about Sergio. Carmen has a creative breakthrough. Nerea gets exasperated at an interview.

videos.title: Exposed
videos.overview: The subject of Adri's latest photography exhibit takes Val by surprise. Carmen presents her campaign idea after coming to an agreement with Borja.

videos.title: Melt Down
videos.overview: After Adri confronts Val about her novel, it spurs the four close friends to share what they really want to pursue in their lives.

videos.title: Omelet Challenge
videos.overview: Val struggles with writer's block and relationship insecurities. Carmen and Borja disagree while apartment-hunting. Nerea makes a romantic decision.

videos.title: Flicker
videos.overview: The women celebrate the success of Val's book with a reading at Lola's apartment. Carmen worries Borja is lying to her. Lola reconnects with her mother.

videos.title: Reflection
videos.overview: Val contemplates a title for her sequel. Lola gets a surprise at Victor's house. Nerea scores a new customer. Carmen has tension with Borja's mom.

videos.title: The Bachelorette Party
videos.overview: Val’s new agreement with Víctor backfires. Carmen’s wedding planning doesn’t go smoothly... and neither does her bachelorette trip with the full gang.

videos.title: Balance
videos.overview: As Val prepares to speak on a stage, Nerea jumps back into the dating scene. Lola is taken aback by a young new fling — who might not be a fling after all.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: Victor finally says the words Val needed to hear. Carmen receives fantastic news, but fears she’ll be unable to find a balance.

videos.title: I Was There
videos.overview: An article prompts the girls to go down memory lane and recount stories of teenage love and heartbreaks, shedding light on their shared experiences.

videos.title: Taste You
videos.overview: A steamy story from Bruno raises Val's temperature, and her doubts. Lola opens up to Rai about her relationship issues. Nerea finally finds a match.

videos.title: The Word
videos.overview: A group gyno appointment becomes a confessional — and Carmen delivers big news. Val visits Bruno in Asturias and their love takes a turn for the… stable.

videos.title: Getting Old
videos.overview: Val has a hard time with Bruno’s straightforwardness. Lola’s 30th birthday party brings some people together, and breaks others apart for good.

videos.title: The Decision
videos.overview: Val finishes novel number two. Carmen’s wedding day arrives but packs chaos, making the girls scramble while also deciding who to attend with.
